notes.text: The linked Bavli gives Guryon ben Astyon speaking in the name of Rav in the discussion of Solomon’s provisions. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=847&lang=en) also gives this chain. Hyman’s short notice uses bar.
